summary: DEF-010 (catalogue half). Deactivates the legacy services_catalog entry with code 'mtd_quarterly' ('MTD Quarterly Submission', £75) across all organizations, leaving the canonical 'mtd_quarter' ('MTD Quarterly Filing') as the only quarterly MTD service the quote builder offers. Sets active = false; the row is NOT deleted. No schema change.

problem.context: The audit found the quote builder offering 'MTD Quarterly Filing — £35.00' beside 'MTD Quarterly Submission — £75.00' with nothing to tell an accountant which to sell.
problem.root_cause: The proposal engine keys on exactly two MTD codes — mtd_quarter and mtd_itsa_final (MTD_SERVICE_CODES in src/lib/proposal/mtd-periods.ts); a tax year decomposes into four mtd_quarter lines plus one mtd_itsa_final. 'MTD Quarterly Submission' is code 'mtd_quarterly', a pre-existing orphan that migration 20260725140000 deliberately left untouched. Its canonical_service_code is NULL and no engine, deadline rule or UI helper matches it.
problem.consequence: Selling the orphan produces a quote line no MTD decomposition recognises: no quarterly periods are generated, no jobs are materialised, and the client is charged for work the engine never schedules.
problem.why_deactivate_not_delete: Historic quotes and quote_lines reference services_catalog by id. Deleting the row would break their line rendering and any job already materialised from it.

expected_objects.object: Every services_catalog row with code 'mtd_quarterly' has active = false
expected_objects.verify_via: db_select services_catalog where code = 'mtd_quarterly' -> every row active = false. Confirm the row still EXISTS (it must not be deleted).

db_select services_catalog where code in ('mtd_quarter','mtd_itsa_final') -> all rows still active = true with unchanged prices. These are what the engine decomposes a tax year into; deactivating either would silently stop MTD job materialisation.

expected_objects.object: The quote builder lists exactly one quarterly MTD service
expected_objects.verify_via: Open the proposal dialog for an MTD client and confirm 'MTD Quarterly Submission' no longer appears while 'MTD Quarterly Filing' does.

rollback.assessment: Trivial and safe: UPDATE services_catalog SET active = true WHERE code = 'mtd_quarterly'. Doing so restores the ambiguity the audit raised.
rollback.data_risk: None. One boolean column on a catalogue row; no quote, line or job is modified, and no row is removed.

post_apply_followups: DEF-010 is not fully closed by this. Two catalogue questions remain and both need an owner ruling, recorded in docs/audits/2026-07-28-remediation-plan.md §6: (1) whether sa_mtd should stay quotable for an MTD client — it is NOT a duplicate to retire, since it carries canonical_service_code 'self_assessment_mtd_quarterly' and doubles as the client type, but offering it beside four quarters and a final declaration lets one obligation be billed twice; (2) the three services priced at 0.00 (LLP accounts production, Sole trader accounts, Trust Registration Service). Zero means 'Included' throughout the product (isIncludedLine — excluded from both totals and from the Stripe line-item builders), so those rows currently quote as free of charge. The owner has ruled that no warning is to be shown when a line is added at zero, so the only remaining lever is pricing the catalogue rows.
